title: RetiJev: Fast and Source-Grounded Ophthalmic Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ophthalmic clinical decision support requires fast, accurate, and privacy-preserving inference, yet autoregressive large language models (LLMs) incur substantial latency and computational overhead for decisions among predefined actions. We therefore investigate a decision-oriented alternative to generative reasoning. Specifically, we first introduce RetiJev-Data, a source-grounded ophthalmology corpus comprising 78,158 clinical-decision and diagnosis questions derived from articles in PubMed Central and a MeSH vocabulary covering 531 eye diseases, and 50,074 guideline-grading questions spanning 11 grading systems, along with a 24,662-question evaluation benchmark. Based on this, we develop RetiJev, a family of 0.8B-9B decision models that directly score candidate answers without autoregressive decoding. Across all model sizes, RetiJev outperforms both a 27B LLM and the commercial Jev 1.13 decision model on guideline grading by 10.4-23.0

translated_title: RetiJev：快速且具有来源依据的眼科决策模型
translated_abstract: 眼科临床决策支持需要快速、准确且保护隐私的推理，然而自回归大语言模型在预定义动作之间进行决策时会产生显著的延迟和计算开销。因此，我们研究了一种面向决策的生成式推理替代方案。具体而言，我们首先推出了RetiJev-Data，这是一个具有来源依据的眼科语料库，包含源自PubMed Central文章的78,158个临床决策与诊断问题（配有覆盖531种眼病的MeSH词汇表）、横跨11个分级系统的50,074个指南分级问题，以及一个包含24,662个问题的评估基准。在此基础上，我们开发了RetiJev，这是一系列0.8B至9B参数的决策模型，无需自回归解码即可直接对候选答案进行评分。在所有模型规模上，RetiJev在指南分级任务上均以10.4-23.0个百分点的优势超越了27B大语言模型和商业Jev 1.13决策模型（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出RetiJev——一系列无需自回归解码、可直接对候选答案评分的0.8B-9B眼科决策模型，并构建了来源可溯的RetiJev-Data语料库，在指南分级任务上以10.4-23.0个百分点的优势超越27B大语言模型和商业决策模型，同时实现更快、更保护隐私的推理。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RetiJev, a family of 0.8B-9B decision models that directly score candidate answers without autoregressive decoding, built on the source-grounded RetiJev-Data ophthalmology corpus, outperforming a 27B LLM and a commercial decision model on guideline grading by 10.4-23.0 points with faster, privacy-preserving inference.
